body.condition: For every \(\ell\) and every \(t\in\{1,\ldots,T_0\}\cup\{T_0+1,\ldots,T_0+T_1\}\), \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}=\sum_{j=1}^Jw_{\ell j}Q_{jt,\ell}\) almost everywhere on \([0,1]\), with the same \(w_\ell\) in all periods; for \(t>T_0\), \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}\) is the treated unit's counterfactual no-intervention quantile law, not the observed intervention law \(Q^I_{0t,\ell}\).
